name: hto-boardwalk-walk
js: (()=>{const a=window.__CITY_APP,C=window.CITY;let p=null;for(let x=-850;x<-800&&!p;x+=.5)for(let z=675;z<695;z+=.5){const q=C.htoLandscapeSurfaceAt(x,z);if(q?.kind==='boardwalk'){p={x,z,h:q.h};break;}}if(!p)throw Error('no boardwalk');a.selectMode('person');a.teleportTo(p.x,p.z,0,p.h);const g=a.controllerManager.getGroundHeight(p.x,p.z,'person',p.h);if(Math.abs(g-p.h)>.01)throw Error('boardwalk curb override '+g+' != '+p.h);a.cameraSystem.cinema=()=>({pos:[p.x-4,p.h+2,p.z+3],look:[p.x+12,p.h+1,p.z],fov:60});return p;})()

name: centre-beach-route-walk
js: (()=>{const a=window.__CITY_APP,C=window.CITY,cs=C.waterfrontIslandAccess.surfaces.corridors.filter(c=>c.dockId==='centre');if(!cs.length)throw Error('missing route surfaces');let last=null;for(const c of cs)for(let i=0;i+1<c.nodes.length;i++){const x=(c.nodes[i][0]+c.nodes[i+1][0])/2,z=(c.nodes[i][1]+c.nodes[i+1][1])/2;const h=C.islandAccessSurfaceAt(x,z),g=a.controllerManager.getGroundHeight(x,z,'person',c.y);if(!h||Math.abs(g-h.h)>.025)throw Error('route footing '+g+' '+JSON.stringify(h));last={x,z,h:g};}a.selectMode('person');a.teleportTo(last.x,last.z,0,last.h);a.cameraSystem.cinema=()=>({pos:[last.x+4,last.h+2,last.z+5],look:[last.x,last.h+1,last.z-10],fov:60});return{segments:cs.length,...last};})()
